configuration.changes: New network source;5x6 Conv3 window and259x260 pad stream handle adjacent pairs and discard output column255. Weight coefficients are split signed-low8+256*residual[-2,2] inside the PE; no accuracy loss.
configuration.conclusion: Use the passing exact10 point only if all resource caps hold; full INT8 is not accepted.

estimates.basis: P07 maps one exact10 pair to1 DSP but454 total LUT, including scalar interface/control. Estimate240 LUT per parallel pair in the full engine, plus12000 fixed overhead. Conv3 uses2*T folds per adjacent pair and32/(2*T) channel lanes. Baseline pixel fill/drain adds about16 cycles; line/FIFO storage follows gather control.

configuration.interpretation: Compare DSP halving to residual/borrow LUT cost and pixel scheduling. Preserve any resource excess; exact10 is chosen because uniform INT8 loses5.18dB.
configuration.name: exact10_packing_T4
configuration.purpose: Integrate the measured exact10 residual PE. Conv1/Conv2 pair output channels sharing each input. Conv3 pairs adjacent outputs sharing each weight, centers the upper nonnegative activation by256, repairs signed-low borrowing, then restores both coefficient residuals. Decode every product, so no low-field accumulation bound is assumed. Preserve all first-phase quantization points.
